scope: Retrospective reliability qualification of released, jointly processed PRISM assay-repeat drug contrasts; no model fitting, purchasing policy, mechanism attribution or superiority test

attachment.relationship: Byte-identical to the previously reviewed recommendation; execute the repeat-stability prerequisite after completed discrepancy P0

question: Do fixed prior-boundary drug response differences reproduce across actual matched detection plates, including primary wrong-order differences?
population: All 106 previously exposed archived evaluation contexts and all 100 prior-top10 versus next10 ordered comparisons per context, 10600 intended cases
recruitment: Prefeedback zero-purchase ranking over the unchanged 3613-drug terminal menu; metadata-only eligibility; no selection using observed response, its magnitude or its finite mask
drug_identity: Exact full Broad ID of the primary archived representative; no prefix, fuzzy, salt or alternate-member substitution
cell_identity: Exact passing STR row identity and HTS002 pool mapping; preserve every unmapped intended context
exposure: Five-day nominal source protocol; sample-specific exposure/culture-start linkage unresolved
endpoint: Within-context, within-compound-plate published log2-fold-change difference: prior-top10 drug minus prior-next10 drug. Negative supports the committed prior order; positive opposes it.
pairing: Both drugs on the same screen and compound plate, matched by actual common detection_plate identities. Never construct a whole-screen repeat by independently sorting different plate sets.
expected_repeats: All common actual detection plates from full treatment metadata; retain absent-header flags and NA rather than shrinking the expected set
metadata_eligibility: Exactly one eligible compound-plate block and at least two header-accessible common actual repeats; preserve all other intended cases and reasons
qc: Accept publisher filtered, ComBat-corrected logfold-change source. No extra magnitude/QC outlier threshold or clipping; all nonfinite selected values remain missing. No raw MFI validation claim.
complete_case: At least two expected repeats and all expected differences finite; partial observations remain partial and cannot supply complete-agreement labels
ties: Exact numerical zero is a tie, reported separately. No biological effect threshold is inferred. Report contrast magnitude alongside sign metrics; arbitrarily small signed differences do not establish useful biological gain.
repeat_direction_diagnostic: Complete cases: all negative, all positive, opposite nonzero signs, all-zero ties, or zero ties mixed with one sign. Discordance denominator is observed repeat-pairs with both differences nonzero; report tied and missing pairs separately.
primary_comparison: Previously exposed archived primary collapsed difference, accessed after this freeze. Primary positive difference is a wrong committed prior order; stable secondary positives support its descriptive repeat/cross-screen reproducibility. No cause or same-culture assertion.
aggregation: Retain all intended pair records and all 106 context records. Summarize eligibility/completeness and context-macro rates with explicit contributing denominators. Pair and plate comparisons are dependent; no significance test, bootstrap, independence claim or coverage guarantee.
terminal_selection: Full-menu top10 utility remains NOT_EVALUABLE unless every fixed selected identity is source-qualified. Do not replace missing drugs or use the eligible pair subset as an acquisition advantage benchmark.
freeze: Protocol, executable, metadata cases/contexts/manifests, archive commitments/predictions and source outcome bytes hashed before new secondary response values are loaded
continuation: This assay-repeat diagnosis may be non-evaluable or negative. It cannot reopen fixed8 tuning or release P1/P2. A new functional policy needs a qualified distinct evidence channel, prespecified useful margin, actual cost basis and justified evaluation units.
